description: Side-by-side comparison of 2 to 4 Arc token contracts: liquidity, exit checks, holders, and pool state. $0.005 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.
